phase: Compatibility reader first; ordinary/dedicated ingestion producers are not active. Full M3 remains open.
implementation: Version1 strict confirmed-taken value with exact frozen label, dose serving, actual vs confirmation time, source-native mineral basis, unknown formulation fields, immutable original/current and bounded correction snapshots. Reject orphan/repeated/contradictory correction history.

Use existing encrypted Experience records and existing schema. No new nutrition/intake table, optimizer, inference model or migration. New kind is explicit supplement-intake; generic workspace consumers exclude it.

Projection uses canonical label scaling, only current value once. Original/history are provenance, never extra doses. Unknown/compound mineral basis or absent label-serving basis stays unknown; other native label declarations not converted/added again.

Quality reviews and schedules do not validate as confirmed ingestion. A confirmation made before takenAt never matures into actual ingestion with passing time. Owner IDs and exact record/source date remain separate from retrieval/formulation dates.

Generic create/edit/delete denied400 for intake records; spent-intent kind hidden and protected from generic delete, excluded before workspace count limits/account export. Future dedicated controls must enforce source review, current lifecycle, CAS/retry and actual erasure semantics.
Private explicit-kind reader, reload and source export supported. Default reads do not silently pass new intake records to older food/activity/wellbeing consumers.
